adjudicated.jp: 机に突っ伏して寝ていたらしい。
adjudicated.en: Seems I had fallen prostrate on the desk and slept.
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese says he apparently fell asleep slumped face-down over the desk. 'Fallen prostrate' suggests a full-body posture and coordinating it with 'slept' obscures the single event.
